message:
We've all been there—suddenly caught off-guard in a situation where we wish we had a plan. 🚗 This handy resource from Ready.gov walks us through essential tips for being prepared while on the road, whether it's a simple trip to the grocery store or a longer journey. Knowing what to do and having a few items ready can help us feel more in control and less stressed when unexpected bumps come our way. 

Let’s embrace that feeling of finally being the prepared one for once! What’s your go-to tip for staying ready while traveling?
